description: Isobaric-triplet (IMME) decomposition of the canonical residual log_q0 Δ_λ = a + b·T₃ + c·T₃². Mirror PAIRS (PR #3089) measure only the bar-odd b; the bar-even QUADRATIC c is invisible to them (it cancels in the mirror difference, Lean mirror_baseline_cancels) and needs a TRIPLET. A=6 (⁶He/⁶Li/⁶Be): a=36.12, b=−1.73 (consistent with the mirror b's −1.34@A3,−1.77@A7), c=−1.24 NONZERO. Askey: body-order b-ladder is continuous q-Hermite (3-term recurrence); IMME is the degree-2 T₃ truncation (Wigner rank-≤2 isotensor = Askey–Racah cutoff). SAME-T RESOLUTION: correcting the T₃=0 member to its T=1 isobaric analog state (IAS: ⁶Li 3.563, ⁸Be 16.626 MeV) COLLAPSES the quadratic c: A=6 −1.24→−0.11, A=8 −3.44→−0.10 — small and A-independent. The raw growth was T=0/T=1 structure (Wigner energy), NOT the IMME quadratic; the genuine same-T c≈−0.1 is small vs the linear b, so the cleaned residual is linear(writhe)-dominated. Not wired; near-match; no fit.

data.imme_form: log_q0 Δ_λ(T₃) = a(A) + b(A)·T₃ + c(A)·T₃²,  T₃=(Z−N)/2

parity.b_linear: bar-ODD (T₃-odd) — the writhe Z-correction; mirror diff=2b·T₃
parity.c_quadratic: bar-EVEN (T₃-even) — cancels in mirror pairs; triplet 2nd diff=2c

askey.body_order_n: b-ladder a(n+2)=2cosh(10η)a(n+1)−a(n): continuous q-Hermite / Al-Salam–Chihara three-term recurrence (Askey q-scheme)
askey.isospin_T3: IMME degree-2 in T₃ = Wigner rank-≤2 isotensor truncation (Askey–Racah cutoff; no d·T₃³)

same_T_resolution.method: T₃=0 member corrected to its T=1 IAS (measured E_x, not a fit)
same_T_resolution.finding: raw c (−1.24,−3.44, growing) was mostly T=0/T=1 Wigner-energy structure; the clean same-T c≈−0.1 is SMALL and A-INDEPENDENT — the residual is linear(writhe)-dominated once same-T
